$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^2+y^2}}(\sin\theta + x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)$$

$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^2+y^2}}(\sin\theta + x\sin\theta + y\cos\theta)$$

$$f_2 - f_1 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^2+y^2}}(2y\cos\theta) - \frac{2\sqrt{2}}{(1+x^2+y^2)^{3/2}}\left((x^2-y^2)\sin(\theta+\varphi) + 2xy\cos(\theta+\varphi)\right)$$
